item.description: Underground caves beneath South Australia's Nullarbor Plain could have the answer to finding life on Mars, according to new research.

item.title: ABC News: Get rules in place to hold data centres to account, experts tell Tasmania
item.description: An artificial intelligence institute warns there may not be much economic benefit from data centre developments if public authorities don't put binding conditions on proponents.

item.title: ABC News: Soon-to-be empty nester wants to rent out rooms but put off by tax
item.description: In some countries, homeowners can take in boarders with a tax-free threshold to incentivise renting out spare rooms.

item.title: ABC News: Gloomy forecast for south-east Queensland before skies clear again
item.description: The Bureau of Meteorology is predicting wet and cloudy conditions for Monday and Tuesday throughout the south-east corner, before the sunshine returns later in the week.

item.title: ABC News: Serious NDIS complaints languishing as regulator grapples with backlog
item.description: NDIS participants say serious reports of abuse, neglect and fraud are languishing as internal data reveals the regulator is grappling with a significant backlog of complaints.

item.title: ABC News: Forty years after whaling was banned, threats remain
item.description: Since whaling was banned in 1986, whale numbers have rebounded but threats, mostly human-made, remain and are on the agenda at a meeting in Hobart.

item.title: ABC News: Ambulance service only fully meets 17 per cent of safety and quality standards
item.description: An ambulance service wanted to see if it could meet national safety and quality standards, but in a mock assessment, only fully met 17 per cent of actions — a result described as "diabolical" by a paramedics' union.

item.title: ABC News: Migration cuts, AI and rising interest rates means an era of long-term disinflation
item.description: The Reserve Bank will increase interest rates on Tuesday, but three new factors entirely outside the bank's control are pulling rates in different directions.

item.title: ABC News: Lost songs of Australian rock legend found buried in a garage
item.description: Divinyls lead singer Chrissy Amphlett was a rock icon who lived hard and burned bright — but the woman underneath was far more vulnerable. Australian Story reveals a private Chrissy through previously unseen footage and three songs that went missing for 25 years.

item.title: ABC News: Banks cut rewards programs, free travel insurance amid surcharge ban
item.description: Sweeping reforms from the Reserve Bank start this week, as banks hike fees and slash rewards programs in preparation.

item.title: ABC News: A rate rise tomorrow is all but locked in. How many more might there be?
item.description: The Reserve Bank is meeting tomorrow for the sixth time this year, and both financial markets and economists think it is almost certain that it will raise interest rates for the fourth time.

item.title: ABC News: How seriously should we take biological threats from AI?
item.description: AI companies say their tools could be used to make biological weaponry. These are the threats and what can be done to mitigate them.

item.title: ABC News: Russia's hybrid attacks have Germans rethinking Nazi-era protections
item.description: European intelligence officials say Russia is behind hundreds of hybrid attacks on the continent this year, and that Western allies are too complacent in the face of Moscow's increasing aggression.

item.title: ABC News: Rinehart allegedly tried to help recruit Liberal MP to join One Nation
item.description: One Nation's billionaire backer Gina Rinehart allegedly attempted to help recruit a sitting federal Liberal MP at one of her holiday homes.
